title: Scholia vetera in Apollonium Rhodium: unit Book 2 / Scholia to the Argonautica / Схолии к «Аргонавтике» Аполлония Родосского
author: Anonymous; per the subscription, derived from Lucillus of Tarrha, Sophocleus and Theon
date: 1st c. BCE–2nd c. CE sources; MSS 10th c.+
size: Wendel: xxvi + 401 pp. (est. ~140k words). Book 2: est. ~30k words.
edition: Wendel 1935 (Weidmann). Wendel died 1951, so PD in RU/EU; US status needs checking. Keil 1854 (in Merkel's edition) is PD.
ru_evidence: Ancientrome.ru catalogue has no Apollonius scholia. Ru-wiki 'Схолии' names them among important but untranslated corpora.
en_evidence: Cuypers' Hellenistic Bibliography lists only Lachenaud's French translation (2010), and BMCR 2014.12.27 likewise names only the French one. No English translation is listed.
other_translations: French: Lachenaud, Scholies à Apollonios de Rhodes (Belles Lettres, Fragments 9, 2010; xlv + 576 pp.).
value: A treasury of lost mythographers and historians (Pherecydes, Herodorus and others). Book 2 covers the Bosporus, the Pontic coast, the Amazons and Colchis: Black Sea ethnography of direct interest to Russian, Ukrainian and Georgian readers and archaeologists.
ai_feasibility: High-medium. Clear explanatory prose, but many toponyms and source citations, so outputs need a gazetteer (e.g., ToposText/Pleiades) and fragment cross-checks.
pilot_unit: Scholia to Book 2 (Amycus, Phineus, Symplegades, the Pontic periplus); est. ~30k words. Lines 2.1–647 (~12k words) would be a smaller pilot.
